declarations.name: AuiErrorSummary

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Heading text. Default: localized "There is a problem".

inputs.name: focusOnShow
inputs.description: Move focus to the summary when show() displays items. show(items, { focus }) overrides it per call.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: A summary link was activated and focus moved to its target.

properties.name: isVisible
properties.description: Read-only: True while items are shown.

methods.name: show
methods.signature: show(items: readonly ErrorSummaryItem[], options?: { focus?: boolean; } | undefined): void
methods.description: Replace the items and show the summary (an empty list hides it). Focuses and scrolls to the summary unless focus is false or focusOnShow is false. Throws on an empty message before changing anything.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Remove all items and hide the summary without moving focus.

accessibility.pattern: GOV.UK error summary: a focusable, labelled region with a native heading and a list of in-page links to the invalid fields.

limitations: A target without an id receives a generated id (the consumer element is modified).
Link activation is handled in script; without script the #id link only scrolls, and focus lands on the target only if it is focusable.
Heading levels are limited to 2, 3, and 4.
